inputs.temperature_status: IMPORTED/EMPIRICAL FIRAS-fixed observer-side datum; not an independent CMB prediction

theorem_A.target: count effective radiation degrees of freedom from the reduced stack

positive_result_A_gamma.statement: Within the continuous gauge-invariant quasi-free CCR class on h_ph, the reduced stack determines a unique bosonic thermal photon sector at T_IO.

operator_content.gauge_action: central scalar only, K_hat_g = K_gauge I

no_go_A_full.statement: No functional of the reduced bosonic-plus-central data can recover fermionic species multiplicity.
no_go_A_full.reason: Theorem 20.R5: for every N_f, M_full(N_f) = M_red tensor CAR(L^2(R,dnu) tensor C^2 tensor C^{N_f}) has identical restriction to M_red. Therefore multiplicity is invisible on the reduced stack.
no_go_A_full.missing_object: a nontrivial family multiplicity operator on an unreduced CAR sector

theorem_B.target: map thermal count object to physical radiation energy density

photon_sector_mapping.statement: The unique reduced photon KMS covariance gives the standard photon blackbody energy density at T_IO.
photon_sector_mapping.formula: rho_gamma(T) = (pi^2/15) T^4 in units c = hbar = k_B = 1

reduced_center_no_go.statement: The central scalar Z_g can dilate frequencies / temperatures, but it does not add an independent multiplicity prefactor.
reduced_center_no_go.reason: K_gauge acts through omega -> exp(K_gauge lambda) omega and therefore changes T, not the number of one-particle copies. Extra species would require h_ph -> h_ph tensor C^m or a CAR extension, not a central scalar on the same h_ph.

theorem_C.target: inject the resulting energy density into the bare Friedmann radiation slot

photon_only_slot.statement: On the reduced stack, the only theorem-grade radiation contribution is the photon slot rho_gamma(T_IO).

comparison_to_standard_parameterization.meaning: To move from imported N_eff = 3.044 to the D/H-matching N_eff, the radiation slot needs an extra 0.083786702704 times the photon energy density.

no_go_full.statement: No reduced-stack operator currently maps into an additional delta N_eff ~= 0.36893 radiation contribution.
no_go_full.reason: The reduced algebra already fixes the photon thermal law, while fermionic multiplicity and reheating are invisible on M_red. So the full Friedmann radiation slot cannot be internally completed without extending the algebra.

minimal_extension_schema.algebra: M_rad_ext(N_f) = M_th tensor CAR(L^2(R,dnu) tensor C^2 tensor C^{N_f}) tensor A_dec

roles.CAR_family_factor: supplies a genuine multiplicity operator Tr_{C^{N_f}} I = N_f
roles.A_dec: weak-decoupling / reheating algebra controlling T_nu / T_gamma

theorem_targets.A_ext: derive a thermal multiplicity count from the CAR family factor
theorem_targets.B_ext: derive fermion energy density with 7/8 weighting and reheating factor
theorem_targets.C_ext: insert that energy density into the bare Friedmann radiation slot

verdict.summary: The three desired full radiation-slot theorems do not close on the reduced stack. What does close is the photon subsector: unique photon KMS covariance, unique photon blackbody density, and therefore the photon-only piece of the radiation slot. The missing delta N_eff requires an unreduced fermionic CAR family sector plus weak-decoupling / reheating dynamics.
